```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say nothing\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stream\":true}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chatStream(request: _request)
var chunks: [LiterLlm.ChatCompletionChunk] = []
        for try await _chunk in result { chunks.append(_chunk) }
print(result)
```
